title: Nintendo raises the Switch 2 price to $499.99
question: How will Nintendo fans and prospective Switch 2 buyers react to this over the first two weeks, which groups will push back and why, and is Nintendo likely to keep, change or reverse the decision?

objections.text: The console was already too expensive; $500 is too much for a Nintendo handheld
Buyers waiting for a price cut got a rise instead and will not buy
Regional prices (nearly C$700 in Canada) are poor value next to a stronger PS5

backdown.summary: The increase was kept; still going ahead days before its 1 September 2026 effective date, with no reversal reported

pushback_groups: prospective buyers waiting for a discount
notes: CONTROL CASE: announced before the model's June 2026 cutoff, so the model may know it. Use it to compare against the unseen cases. The reaction was negative but resigned (industry-wide price rises), with no organised campaign.
